main.content:
==English==

===Etymology===
{{root|en|ine-pro|*deh₃-}}
From {{inh|en|enm|adden}}, from {{der|en|la|addō||add, give unto}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/æd/}}, {{enPR|ăd}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-add.ogg|a=US}}
* {{rhymes|en|æd|s=1}}
* {{homophones|en|ad}}

===Verb===
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[join]] or [[unite]] (e.g. one thing to another, or as several [[particular]]s) so as to increase the number, augment the quantity{{,}} or enlarge the magnitude, or so as to form into one aggregate.
# To [[sum up]]; to put together mentally; to [[add up]].
#: {{co|en|to '''add''' numbers}}
#* {{RQ:Locke Human Understanding|text={{...}}as easily as he can '''add''' together the ideas of two days or two years.}}
#* {{RQ:Guardian|author=Alec Wilkinson|title=Could learning algebra in my 60s make me smarter?|url=https://www.theguardian.com/books/2022/aug/07/could-learning-algebra-in-my-60s-make-me-smarter-alec-wilkinson-a-divine-language-extract|date=2022-08-07|passage=I could '''add''' and subtract and multiply and divide, but I entered the wilderness when words became equations.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20230322221914/https://www.theguardian.com/books/2022/aug/07/could-learning-algebra-in-my-60s-make-me-smarter-alec-wilkinson-a-divine-language-extract}}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To combine elements of (something) into one quantity.
#: {{co|en|to '''add''' a column of numbers}}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To give by way of increased possession (to someone); to bestow (on).
#* {{RQ:KJV|Genesis|30|24|passage=The {{smallcaps|Lord}} shall '''add''' to me another son.}}
#* {{RQ:Milton Paradise Lost|passage=Back to thy punishment, False fugitive, and to thy speed '''add''' wings.|year=1873}}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To append (e.g. a statement); to say further information.
#* {{RQ:Macaulay History of England|volume=3|page=37|text=He '''added''' that he would willingly consent to the entire abolition of the tax}}
#* {{RQ:Baum Wizard of Oz|chapter=23|passage="Bless your dear heart," she said, "I am sure I can tell you of a way to get back to Kansas." Then she '''added''', "But, if I do, you must give me the Golden Cap."}}
# {{lb|en|intransitive}} To intensify; to augment; to increase.
#: {{ux|en|It '''adds''' to our anxiety.}}
#* {{RQ:KJV|1 Kings|12|14|passage=I will '''add''' to your yoke}}
#* {{RQ:Economist|date=2013-06-29|volume=407|issue=8842|page=72–3
|title=[http://www.economist.com/news/international/science-and-technology/21580133-how-microbes-promote-liver-cancer-overweight-punch-gut A punch in the gut]
|passage=Mostly, the microbiome is beneficial.{{...}}Research over the past few years, however, has implicated it in diseases from atherosclerosis to asthma to autism. Dr Yoshimoto and his colleagues would like to '''add''' liver cancer to that list.}}
# {{lb|en|intransitive|mathematics}} To perform the arithmetical operation of [[addition]].
#: {{ux|en|He '''adds''' rapidly.}}
# {{lb|en|intransitive|video games}} To summon [[minion]]s or [[reinforcement]]s.
#: {{ux|en|Typically, a hostile mob will '''add''' whenever it's within the aggro radius of a player.}}
# {{lb|en|transitive|Internet|text messaging|video games}} To add someone as a friend.

====Usage notes====
* To ''add'' quantities; to ''join'' houses; to ''annex'' territory; to ''unite'' kingdoms; to make parties ''coalesce''.

====Conjugation====
{{en-conj|old=1}}

====Synonyms====
* {{sense|join or unite so as to increase the number}} {{l|en|annex}}; See also [[Thesaurus:add]]
* {{sense|put together mentally}} {{l|en|add up}}, {{l|en|sum}}; See also [[Thesaurus:summate]]
* {{sense|give by way of increased possession}} {{l|en|bestow}}, {{l|en|give}}; See also [[Thesaurus:give]]
* {{sense|combine elements into one quantity}} {{l|en|coalesce}}, {{l|en|join}}, {{l|en|unite}}
* {{sense|say further information}} {{l|en|mention}}, {{l|en|note}}
* {{sense|make an addition}} {{l|en|augment}}, {{l|en|increase}}; See also [[Thesaurus:augment]]
* {{sense|perform the arithmetical operation of addition}}

====Antonyms====
* {{antsense|quantity}} {{l|en|subtract}}
* {{antsense|matter}} {{l|en|remove}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# {{lb|en|radio}} The addition of a [[song]] to a station's [[playlist]].
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2006|author=David Baskerville|title=Music Business Handbook and Career Guide|page=370
|passage=In a typical week, 10 to 15 songs may be up for consideration as “'''adds'''” of new songs for the station's playlist.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2013|author=Russ Hepworth-Sawyer|title=From Demo to Delivery
|passage=Effectiveness of their work is measured by the number of “'''adds'''” they receive on the airplay charts of major trades.}}
# {{lb|en|computer science}} An act or instance of adding.
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2004|author=C. K. Birdsall; A. B. Langdon|title=Plasma Physics via Computer Simulation|page=75
|passage=List the number of '''adds''' and multiplies for each of the forms (6) , (7), and (8).}}
# {{lb|en|video games}} An [[additional]] enemy that joins a fight after the primary target.
#: {{ux|en|When the player has fought the boss for one minute, two '''adds''' will arrive from the back and must be dealt with.}}
